evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Now before we get into the details of your move a new Palma other than the price obviously, do you have any biggest concerns about the move or any questions you want answers to on this call? [asked AFTER address and zip code collection, not before probing starts]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No, there is no biggest concern just I just want to back on more the thought' — rep acknowledged with 'Okay, great!' but did not probe deeper or ask tell-me-more follow-up; when asked 'Any items that you have, you're most concerned about?' customer said 'No nothing else' and rep moved on immediately.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep never mentioned value days, cheaper days, or date flexibility as a money-saving opportunity.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: We do not require a deposit to book, so in case you have changes on your end, we can reschedule and cancel without additional fees. Do you want to lock in the date? [deposit/no-fee commitment stated first, then the ask for the business follows]

top_strength: Danah gathered detailed logistics methodically (floor, elevator access, walking distances, square footage, box count, storage destination, special items) and delivered the core pricing transparency — hourly rate, trip fee, packing materials, no hidden fees, damage coverage, and 2.5-hour minimum — all clearly and completely.
coaching_note: Step 2 and 6 are both missing genuine concern follow-up and checks: the two-concerns question came after probing had started, the customer's initial response was not explored two layers deep, and no final concerns check was asked at all; add those bookend moments back in and hold silence longer when the customer signals they're done.
